newsitem.title: SPAIN: Zaire aid operation dubbed "Phoenix Tusk".
newsitem.headline: Zaire aid operation dubbed "Phoenix Tusk".

text.p: The multinational relief effort for Zaire has been dubbed "Operation Phoenix Tusk", Spain's defence ministry and Western diplomats said on Thursday.

The defence ministry said in a written statement it had authorised U.S. Air Force planes participating in "Operation Phoenix Tusk" to use two Spanish military bases for transiting in response to a U.S. request.

Western diplomats in Madrid confirmed the name of the multinational operation to secure corridors through which humanitarian aid can reach more than a million starving and sick refugees displaced by war in eastern Zaire.
U.S. Defence Secretary William Perry said Washington may send up to 1,000 troops as part of the multinational force.
The Canadian-led force, with a large U.S. contingent, is expected to be on the ground within days.
